description: This is a PHP class file defining the LDAPDao class, which extends BaseDao. The class provides methods for interacting with LDAP-related data, such as fetching users, employee details, LDAP authentication providers, and LDAP synchronization status within an OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes queries involving Doctrine ORM to access and manipulate LDAP and user-related entities.

classes.name: LDAPDao
classes.description: A data access object for handling LDAP-related operations, including user retrieval, employee search, LDAP provider info, and synchronization status within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmpNumbersWhoHaveManyUsers
methods.description: Retrieves employee numbers that are associated with two or more user accounts.

methods.name: getNonLocalUserByUserName
methods.description: Fetches a non-local user (with null password) by username, mainly used for LDAP authentication.

methods.name: getUserByUserName
methods.description: Fetches a user by username if the user is not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getAuthProviderByUserUniqueId
methods.description: Retrieves the LDAP authentication provider info for a user based on their unique LDAP user ID.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Searches for an employee entity matching provided LDAP filter parameters, raising exception if no search parameter is provided.

methods.name: getAllLDAPAuthProviders
methods.description: Returns all LDAP authentication providers associated with non-deleted users.

methods.name: getLastLDAPSyncStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent LDAP synchronization status record.
